# Driver (stage 2): IR2110 half-bridge

> English (primary) · [Русский](../../translations/ru/hardware/driver/README.md) · [Deutsch](../../translations/de/hardware/driver/README.md)

**Schematic:** [../schematics/sch1-driver-halfbridge.png](../schematics/sch1-driver-halfbridge.png) (generated by [../schematics/render_schematics.py](../schematics/render_schematics.py))

The chain: Pi (SPI) → AD9833 **in square-wave mode** (OPBITEN bit: MSB routed to the output, rail-to-rail swing — no separate comparator needed) → **74HC14 + RC + 1N4148** shaper (complementary HIN/LIN with ~1 µs dead time) → IR2110 → 2×IRF540 (half-bridge) → 1 µF DC-blocking cap → matching transformer (ferrite, ~1:3..1:5, tune to fit) → Langevin transducer TX.

The AD9833's sine output (~0.6 Vpp) is no good for the IR2110 logic — if for some reason you specifically need a sine out of the DDS, put a comparator between them (e.g. an LM393, not in the BOM).

Power stage supply: 12–24 V bench PSU with current limiting (start at 0.2 A!).

Note: the stage-1 sweep drives the piezo directly with the weak DDS sine (~0.6 Vpp, see sweep_map.py) — the driver enters the chain at stage 2 (watts).

Notes:
- The Langevin transducer is a capacitive load (nF); a series inductor/transformer is mandatory, otherwise the MOSFETs cook on reactive current.
- **Dead time**: the IR2110 does not generate it on its own. The discrete-parts option — RC+1N4148 on the 74HC14 inputs (delays rising edges only, ~1 µs; with a 25 µs period at 40 kHz that's <5% loss). The easy option — an EGS002 module, everything is built in there.
- **3.3 V logic**: power the IR2110's VDD from the same 3.3 V as the AD9833 and 74HC14 — at VDD=5 V the VIH threshold is ≈ 3.1 V and a 3.3 V square wave barely squeaks through (the datasheet allows VDD down to 3.3 V).
- **Decoupling is mandatory**: 100 nF at VDD and VCC (VCC — plus 47 µF), and on the power rail 470–1000 µF + 100 nF ceramic right at the half-bridge legs — without this, a half-bridge on breadboard jumpers picks up its own switching spikes.
- First power-up: no plate, Langevin transducer in air, minimum power, check the waveform on a scope/ADC.
